content: The global dietary supplement market has grown significantly over the past decade, driven by rising consumer awareness of health and wellness. Companies are innovating with new ingredients such as adaptogens, probiotics, and plant-based extracts. Market analysts project a continued compound annual growth rate (CAGR) exceeding 8% through 2030, supported by increased disposable income and aging populations in developed economies. Regulatory frameworks are tightening, requiring stricter labeling and safety certifications. Many brands are now focusing on sustainability and clean-label formulations to attract health-conscious millennials and Gen Z consumers. While North America remains the largest market, Asia-Pacific is witnessing the fastest growth, especially in China and India. Research and development investments are also expanding, with companies exploring novel delivery formats like gummies, powders, and functional beverages. The competitive landscape includes major players like Nestlé Health Science, Herbalife, Amway, and smaller boutique brands catering to niche demands.
